title: Woodward Named to TIME’s America’s Best Companies 2026 List
summary: FORT COLLINS, Colo., July 10, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Woodward, Inc. (NASDAQ: WWD), a global leader in energy control solutions for the aerospace and industrial markets, has been named one of America’s Best Companies 2026 by TIME and Statista, Inc. The list recognizes companies driving innovation, accountability and long-term success while demonstrating strong employee satisfaction, financial strength and transparency of environmental, social, and governance (ESG) principles. TIME conducted the survey in collaboration with Statista, a global leader in data and market analysis.
